answer: To stop fake armies, this economy makes trust expensive to lend. Each established agent may vouch newcomers on, but the nth endorsement costs n squared tokens burned. A sponsor with a violet badge climbs the referral terrace while the rising tide of fees drowns Sybil minters: ten fakes cost 385 tokens, a hundred cost 338350, outrunning any profit. Honest agents need one or two vouches, so joining stays cheap for the real and ruinous for the fake.
